result.topic_en: Calculations on the quartic equation $ax^4+4bx^3+6cx^2+4dx+e=0$: its cubic resolvent invariants (A, B), the discriminant expressed through auxiliary quantities p, q, r, symmetric functions of the roots, and a parametrised family of quartics in variables y, z.
result.transcription:
$ax^4+4bx^3+6cx^2+4dx+e=0$
$(ab-c)^3-(3c^2-4bd+ae)(ab-c)-2(c^3-2cbd-cae+eb^2+ad^2)=0$
$3A$ \quad $B$
$9A=4((\gamma^2-1)y^2+(\beta^2-1)z^2+(a-2\alpha+2\beta\gamma)yz)^2-12yz(((\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz)-a(y^2+z^2+2\alpha yz)))=4p^2-12q$
$27B=8(\;)^3-36yz(\;)((\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz)-a(y^2+z^2+2\alpha yz))+27y^2z^2(by+cz)^2=8p^3-36qp+27r$
$27^2B^2-9^3A^3=8^2p^6-2\cdot8\cdot36\,qp^4+2\cdot8\cdot27\,p^3r+36^2q^2p^2-2\cdot36\cdot27\,qpr+27^2r^2$
$-(4^3p^6-3\cdot[-16-]\,12\,qp^4+3\cdot4\cdot12^2p^2q^2-12^3q^3$
$q=(\beta b-ac)\gamma,\ p=\beta^2-c+a\gamma,\ r=\gamma^2b^2$
$16p^3r-16p^2q^2+4\cdot16q^3-2\cdot36\cdot pqr+27r^2$
$16p^3b^2-16p^2(\beta b-ac)^2\gamma+\gamma\cdot4\cdot16\cdot(\beta b-ac)^3-2\cdot36\cdot b^2p(\beta b-ac)\gamma+27\gamma^2b^4$
$pb^2=\beta^2b^2-cb^2+ab^2\gamma$
$q^2=\beta^2b^2-2ab\beta c+a^2c^2$
$16p^2(pr-q^2)+8q(8q^2-9pr)$
$16(p^2-4q)(pr-q^2)-8qpr+27r^2$
$\beta^4-2\beta^2c+2\beta^2a\gamma+c^2-2ca\gamma+a^2\gamma^2$
$-4\beta b\gamma+4ac\gamma$
$\frac{pr-q^2}{\gamma^2}=[-b^2\beta^2-b^2-]-cb^2+ab^2\gamma+2ab\beta c+a^2\gamma^2$
$\partial^2=2(ab-c)a+4(b^2-ac)$
$2\partial=x_1+x_2-x_3-x_4$
$x_1+x_2+x_3-x_4$
$x_1-x_2-x_3+x_4$
$x_1^3+x_2^3+x_3^3+x_4^3-x_1^2(x_2+x_3+x_4)+2x_1(x_2x_3+x_3x_4+x_2x_4)$
$(x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4)^3\quad(x_1^3)+3(x_1^2x_2)+6(x_1x_2x_3)$
$-4x_1^2x_2$
$[?](x_1x_2)=3(x_1x_2x_3)+(x_1^2x_2)$
$(x_1)^3-4(x_1^2x_2)-4(x_1x_2x_3)$
$(x_1)^3-4(x_1)(x_1x_2)+8(x_1x_2x_3)$
$(4b)^3-4(4b)(6c)+8(4d)$
$2b^3-3bc+d$
$=2b^3-3abc+da^2$

$3c^2-ab^2[?]+ae$
$(3c^2-ac)=3(\gamma y+\beta z)^2-[(1+\gamma^2)y^2+(1+\beta^2)z^2+2yz(\alpha+2\beta\gamma)]$
$=(\gamma y+\beta z)^2-2\alpha yz-(y^2+z^2+2\alpha yz)$
$2b^3-3abc+a^2d=(\gamma y+\beta z)(\ldots)-[(y^2+z^2+2\alpha yz)-2\alpha yz)$
$=yz(by+cz)-2a(\gamma y+\beta z)\ldots(\gamma y^2+\beta z^2)+yz(b+\beta+2\alpha\gamma)y+(c+\gamma+2\alpha\beta)z)$
$(\gamma y+\beta z)(y^2+z^2+2\alpha yz)+yz(by+cz)$
$a=1$
$b=\gamma y+\beta z$
$3c=2(\gamma y+\beta z)^2+(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)+2\alpha yz$
$d=(\gamma y+\beta z)(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)+yz(by+cz)$
$e=(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)^2$
$(x^2+2x(\gamma y+\beta z)+(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2))^2+4xyz(ax+by+cz)=0$
$(x^2+2ax+b)^2+4x(\alpha x+\beta)=0\quad x=\frac{\beta}{\xi^2+\alpha}$
$(\beta^2-2\alpha\beta(\xi^2+1)+b(\xi^2+1)^2)^2+4\beta^2(\xi^2+1)^2\xi^2\alpha^3=0$
$(by+cz)^2-2(\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz)(\xi^2+1)a+a^2(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)(\xi^2+1)^2$
$-2(\xi^2+1)\xi(by+cz)a^{\frac32}\sqrt{yz}=0$
$a=[-1-](y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)$
$b=-\frac12(by+cz)[-a^2-]\sqrt{yz}$
$3c=a^2(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)-a(\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz)\cdot1$
$d=-\frac12(by+cz)a\sqrt{yz}$
$e=(by+cz)^2-2a(\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz)+a^2(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)$
$3c^2-12bd+3ae=a^4(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)^2-2a(\gamma y+\beta z)((by+cz)(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)+(\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz))^2$
$+3\quad-6$
$-3ayz(by+cz)+3(by+cz)^2(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)$
$+3$
$4(a(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2)^2-(\gamma y+\beta z)(by+cz))^2+3(by+cz)^2(y^2+2\alpha yz+z^2-(\gamma y+\beta z)^2)$
$-ayz$

methods.what: Cubic resolvent of the general quartic in terms of invariants
Expressing invariants A, B via auxiliary quantities p, q, r
Discriminant $27^2B^2-9^3A^3$ expanded in p, q, r
Power-sum / symmetric function identities for the roots, giving $2b^3-3abc+a^2d$
Parametrised family of quartics with coefficients in y, z
